result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: it is mutual, limited to personnel directly involved, capped at 12 months after each person’s involvement, retains carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited inquiries, and does not prohibit hiring. The changes are confined to the non-solicit’s scope, duration, and mutuality. Drafting is generally professional, though “performance or receipt of this Agreement” would be clearer as “performance or receipt of the services,” and the agreement-level duration is somewhat redundant with the individual involvement cap.
